figure.teaching_claim: Bit and mixed-radix reversal permute which source index occupies each destination address; they do not relabel frequency bins, so natural spectral order must be restored before comparison or plotting.

contract.cell_semantics: Each cell gives source index n held at increasing destination address p.
contract.interface: Apply the inverse permutation before associating memory address p with spectral bin k=p.
contract.implementation: Hook-free server component using HTML, shared KaTeX M, palette constants, inline styles, and component-scoped responsive CSS; no semantic figure root or new dependency.
contract.non_color_redundancy: Literal p/n labels, exact sequences, binary arrows, state words, and inverse-permutation direction preserve meaning without hue.

observed_defects: The standalone accessible label omitted the literal stored-index sequences.
The one-column mobile transition retained a rightward arrow, and the ready state did not explicitly state k=p.
history.fix: Expanded the accessible label with both exact sequences and the inverse-permutation condition; changed the forced-mobile transition to a down arrow and made k=p explicit only in the restored state.

history.result: PASS: final light/dark desktop and 312 px mobile renders show no clipping, collision, horizontal overflow, broken math, address-order ambiguity, or theme failure.

checks.mobile_literal_cells: PASS: N=8 remains eight cells; N=12 wraps 4 columns by 3 rows with p repeated in every cell
checks.accessibility: PASS: exact non-color aria-label plus visible text labels and arrows
